site.title: {project} - Ukwabelana Ngamafayela Okuhlukanisiwe
site.description: {project} iyisofthiwe yokwabelana ngamafayela ye-peer-to-peer eyakhelwe phezu kobuchwepheshe besimanje obuhlukanisiwe.
site.ogDescription: Ukwabelana ngamafayela kwe-peer-to-peer okwakhelwe phezu kobuchwepheshe besimanje obuhlukanisiwe. Akukho amaseva amaphakathi. Akukho phuzu elilodwa lokwehluleka.

hero.subtitle: Isizukulwane esilandelayo sokwabelana ngamafayela ku-peer-to-peer
hero.description: Yakhelwe phezu kobuchwepheshe besimanje obuhlukanisiwe. Akukho amaseva amaphakathi. Akukho phuzu elilodwa lokwehluleka.

about.title: Mayelana
about.intro: {project} iyiplathifomu yokwabelana ngamafayela ye-peer-to-peer yesizukulwane esilandelayo eyakhelwe phezu kobuchwepheshe besimanje obuhlukanisiwe. Ihlanganisa isixhumi sezisebenzisi esilula nokwakhiwa okuhlukanisiwe ngokuphelele, inikeza isixazululo esiphephile nesithembekile sokwabelana ngedatha esimele kuwo wonke umthetho omkhulu. Iphrojekthi i-open source futhi isatshalaliswa ngaphansi {license}.

decentralized.title: Inethiwekhi ehlukanisiwe ngokuphelele
decentralized.description: Akukho amaseva amaphakathi, akukho phuzu elilodwa lokwehluleka. Abasebenzisi bafuna futhi balanda okuqukethwe ngqo phakathi kwabo, ngaphandle kokuncika kwizikhomba, abalandeli noma izisekelo zedatha eziphakathi.

accessControl.title: Ukulawula ukufinyelela okucacile
accessControl.description: Wonke umuntu ukhululekile ukuqala inethiwekhi yakhe nemithetho yakhe. Chaza izindima zomsebenzisi kuyo yonke inethiwekhi: abanikazi, abalawuli, abashicileli, abalawuli kanye nabalandayo. Lawula ngokunembile ukuthi ngubani ongashicilela, alawule, futhi alande okuqukethwe.

ui.title: Isixhumi sabasebenzisi esivelele
ui.description: Isixhumi se-media center esicacile nesilula sokusebenzisa esiklanyelwe amaplathifomu we-desktop, TV ne-mobile. Hamba ngaphandle kwezinkinga ngekhibhodi, igundane, igamepad noma ikhomba. Abasebenzisi abahlangene bangasebenzisa isixhumi se-command line ukuqalisa isofthiwe njengeseva yefayela ye-headless.

dataFormat.title: Ifomethi yedatha efundwa ngumuntu
dataFormat.description: Ifomethi yedatha ye-LISH isekelwe ku-JSON, eyenza kube lula ukudala, ukufunda nokuqonda. Yabelana ngokuqukethwe kwakho ngedatha emeta ecacile, esobala engahlolwa kalula nginoma ngubani.

security.title: Ubumfihlo nezokuphepha
security.description: Konke ukuxhumana kwe-peer-to-peer kuyabethelwa, kuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha yakho ihlala iyimfihlo phakathi nokudluliselwa. Abasebenzisi bangacasha ngemuva kwe-VPN ukuze bathole ungqimba olwengeziwe lokungaziwa. {project} ihlonipha ubumfihlo bakho ngokwakheka.

crossPlatform.title: Amaplathifomu ahlukene
crossPlatform.description: Isofthiwe iyatholakala kumaplathifomu we-Windows, Linux ne-macOS. Yisebenzise kunoma yiliphi idivayisi oyithandayo.

download.title: Landa
download.description: Thola {project} ngeplathifomu yakho. Konke ukulanda kumahhala futhi i-open source.

macos.title: Inothi elibalulekile kubasebenzisi be-macOS:
macos.intro: I-macOS Gatekeeper ivimba izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingasayiniwe / ezingaqinisekisiwe ezilandwe ku-inthanethi nephutha le-{error}.
macos.runCommand: Ngemuva kokulanda i-DMG noma i-ZIP, sebenzisa umyalo ku-Terminal ngendlela elandelayo ngaphambi kokuvula uhlelo lokusebenza:
macos.explanation: Lokhu kususa isici se-quarantine futhi sivumela uhlelo lokusebenza ukuthi lusebenze.
